maddeler.e:
تحتضنون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَضِنُونَ (taḥtaḍinūna) /taħ.ta.dˤi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# تُحْتَضَنُونَ (tuḥtaḍanūna) /tuħ.ta.dˤa.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
